milestones.label: Round Two notification
milestones.source_text: The Mandela Rhodes Foundation (official) says applicants learn in mid-July whether they reached Round Two.

milestones.label: Round Three notification
milestones.source_text: Official Foundation page: Round Three outcomes are sent at the end of July.

milestones.label: Invitation to the final-round interview (or unsuccessful notice)
milestones.source_text: Official Foundation page: final-round invitations go out at the end of August.

milestones.label: Final-round interviews in South Africa (applicants abroad are flown in)
milestones.source_text: Official Foundation page: final interviews are held in South Africa in October; applicants based abroad who reach this stage are brought in for an in-person interview.

milestones.label: Selected scholars notified
milestones.source_text: Official Foundation page: successful candidates hear at the end of October, then secure university admission and a visa for a January start.
